Thanks,  but aren't some nodes attractiing more downloads than others. For example Check-In time affects the pools performance. I am wondering if the customer success rate and the rate of the download affects as well.
the customer success rate is On the customer’s side.  Failures are nearly always due to poor connections or low end computers
Download speed is also the client side
well check ins is important ofcourse, if you see like  0 check ins for days the pool is not functioning.... you can also look at the uptime of of the pool / active cycles. To see that it looks proper
It’s difficult to over tax a node pool right now.
I suggest finding a pool that's highest in the rank and closest to maxed out. With your 40 you can alone max out a few pools.
pools that are maxed out will get the highest number of requests. Higher in the rank should ensure that the performance can keep up with all the download requests.
Pools get rewarded by how much data they serve in that region compared to other pools in that same region.
Anyone, feel free to correct me if I'm wrong on all that.
